description: This source file defines the ServiceEcaRule class, which manages Event-Condition-Action rules for services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It parses XML configuration elements to set up conditions and actions that are triggered based on specific service events, providing methods for evaluation and execution of rules, as well as configuration management.

classes.name: ServiceEcaRule
classes.description: Represents a rule for triggering actions based on service events, including conditions and execution logic.

methods.name: getShortDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a short string combining service and event names for display.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the associated service.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the event name associated with this rule.

methods.name: getDefinitionLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the rule's definition in the source XML.

methods.name: getEcaActionList
methods.description: Returns a list of the actions configured for this rule.

methods.name: getEcaConditionList
methods.description: Returns a list of the conditions configured for this rule.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule's conditions and executes actions if conditions are met.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the rule is enabled.
